name: react
description: React single-page app or landing page built with Vite, tested with Vitest and React Testing Library.
module_unit: React component (one .jsx file plus an optional .css file with the same name)
conventions: Function components with a default export named exactly like the module, e.g. `export default function Hero(props)`.
Components are written in PascalCase; `App` is its own module and composes the others by import, e.g. `import Hero from './Hero.jsx'`.

Design must give every component its exact props (name, type, default) and the exact visible text, heading levels, link hrefs, button labels, ARIA roles/labels and data-testid values that tests rely on.
Styles live in `src/components/<Module>.css`, imported by the component; class names are prefixed with the component name in kebab-case to avoid clashes.
Tests import components from `../src/components/<Module>.jsx` and query by role/text (getByRole, getByText); no snapshot tests.
No extra runtime dependencies beyond react and react-dom unless the design lists them.
scaffold: package.json: {"name": <repo name>, "private": true, "type": "module", "scripts": {"dev": "vite", "build": "vite build", "preview": "vite preview", "test": "vitest run"}, dependencies react ^18.3.1 and react-dom ^18.3.1, devDependencies vite ^5.4.0, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.0, vitest ^2.1.0, jsdom ^25.0.0, @testing-library/react ^16.0.0, @testing-library/dom ^10.4.0, @testing-library/jest-dom ^6.5.0}
vite.config.js: plugin react(); test: { environment: 'jsdom', globals: true, setupFiles: './tests/setup.js' }

index.html: standard Vite entry with
, the page from the design, and <script type="module" src="/src/main.jsx">
src/index.css: global reset and the design tokens (colors, fonts) from the design
Run `npm install` and verify `npx vite --version` works. Do not create any component files.
